source.anchor: S2 centered first-order model; S3.E4-E5 actual block precision; A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1 Oracle reduction primitive; A2.Ex33-Ex35; omitted zero-residual convention.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. The selected pointwise oracle identities are Appendix B.1; ASTIS explicitly supplies the genuine quadratic derivative and contiguous-coordinate adapters.
source.scope: Pointwise first-order observation reconstruction only; operational query budgets and information-law lower bounds are separate.

items.statement: Exact forward and inverse block products reconstruct the actual first-order observation of the centered quadratic potential. (f(x),\nabla f(x))=\bigl(\tfrac12\langle x,g(x)\rangle,g(x)\bigr). \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\ge4\). Set \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\), \(r=d\bmod n\), and fix arbitrary actual hidden blocks \(O_1,\ldots,O_k\in O(n)\); no probability law or common determinant sign is assumed. Use the actual precision \(A=\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r)\), where \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), and the actual centered potential \(f(x)=\frac12 x^\top Ax\), with zero additive constant. Write \(x=(x_1,\ldots,x_k,z)\) in contiguous coordinates. In Lean the zero-based embedding sends \((i,j)\) to \(jn+i\) and the residual coordinate \(i\) to \(kn+i\). The case \(r=0\) is included; it has no residual coordinates. The primitive oracle returns exact real products \(O_jv\) or \(O_j^\top v\), tagged false and true respectively. The inverse tag refers to the orthogonal block inverse, not the precision inverse. The output includes genuine Euclidean Fréchet differentiability \(\operatorname{HasGradientAt} f\ g(x)\ x\); a totalized gradient fallback is not used to establish the claim. The reconstructed block is \(g_j(x)=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}x_j-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}\bigl(Q_j^{\mathrm f}(x_j)+Q_j^{\mathrm i}(x_j)\bigr)\). Assemble \(g(x)=(g_1(x),\ldots,g_k(x),z)\); the residual is copied unchanged.

obligations.label: The actual block primitive responses give the genuine gradient and potential of the actual canonical precision.

bindings.boundary: Selected pointwise Appendix B.1 Ex33–35 reconstruction, with a genuine two-hidden-input consumer: equality of all forward/inverse block replies at the same queried point implies equality of their actual (f(x), gradient f(x)) observations. Finite-horizon adaptive simulation, deterministic worst-case per-block2T/total2Tk caps, strict2T<n downstream transcript/output indistinguishability, probability/seed laws, sampling TV precision, expected-cost adaptations, both main lower bounds, remote publication and postmerge purification/Exposition Seal remain separate.
